stories.title: Trump hosts tech executives as administration doubles down on AI
stories.summary: President Trump met with AI CEOs at the White House on Tuesday and promoted a new government AI tool even as concerns about the technology's risks grow.

stories.title: Anger mounts over Cornell's response to student's sexual assault allegations
stories.summary: Prosecutors have reopened an investigation into the alleged rape of a former Cornell University student in 2024. Now the governor of New York is calling for an independent investigation into Cornell.

stories.title: Guitarist Tom Morello gets political on 'Everyone Gets Everything They Want'
stories.summary: NPR's Juana Summers talks with Tom Morello, co-founder of Rage Against the Machine, about his first solo rock record Everyone Gets Everything They Want.

stories.title: The race to protect Santa Rosa Island's rare, damaged Torrey pines
stories.summary: In May, a fire damaged 80% of the trees one of the only two naturally-occurring groves of Torrey Pines in the world. The National Park Service is trying to help them recover.

stories.title: Historic science museum in Philadelphia to close
stories.summary: Philadelphia's Academy of Natural Sciences is set to close down thanks to financial pressures. The 198-year-old museum houses important scientific specimens and a beloved dinosaur exhibit.

stories.title: Nor'easter exposes part of a schooner wrecked on Nantucket
stories.summary: Heavy winds and high seas pounded the Eastern seaboard. But they also revealed the remains of a ship on a Nantucket beach. The wreck is believed to be nearly 150 years old.
